l-eval.description: Compare exact-answer tasks and open-ended requests grounded in long documents.
l-eval.input: Long input document and an instruction
l-eval.output: Short answer, selected option or extended response
l-eval.assessment: Exact-match-style scores for closed tasks; overlap metrics, model judging or human review for open tasks

longbench.description: Read long English and Chinese inputs for tasks such as question answering, summarization and code completion.
longbench.input: Long English or Chinese context and task prompt
longbench.output: Answer, summary, label or code completion
longbench.assessment: Task-specific scores such as F1, ROUGE or code similarity
longbench.date_note: Public integration discussion: the project was available by this date.

needle-in-a-haystack.description: Recover an inserted fact as the length of the surrounding text and the fact’s position change.
needle-in-a-haystack.input: Long passage with a planted fact and question
needle-in-a-haystack.assessment: Original harness: model-graded recall by length and depth
needle-in-a-haystack.date_note: Original author announcement (UTC); the code followed.

infinitebench.description: Evaluate retrieval, reading and code reasoning on real and synthetic inputs exceeding 100K tokens on average.
infinitebench.input: A long context and task-specific question or instruction
infinitebench.output: A retrieved value, answer, choice or summary
infinitebench.assessment: Task-specific scoring, including answer matching, QA F1 and ROUGE for summarization

locomo.description: Retrieve facts from months of dialogue and reconstruct the speakers’ past events; the suite also tests dialogue generation.
locomo.input: Multi-session dialogue plus a question or event-summary request
locomo.output: A short answer or an account of relevant events
locomo.assessment: QA uses normalized answer F1; event summaries use ROUGE and factual precision/recall measures
locomo.first_author_affil: University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill

ruler.description: Increase input length while varying retrieval, multi-hop tracing, aggregation and question answering.
ruler.input: Synthetic long context and a task-specific query
ruler.output: Retrieved values, aggregates or short answers
ruler.assessment: Reference-string coverage or any-match, depending on task

babilong.description: Answer bAbI questions whose supporting facts are separated by unrelated natural text.
babilong.input: A long passage containing task facts, followed by a question
babilong.output: A short answer inferred from those facts
babilong.assessment: Compare with the reference answer; report accuracy by reasoning task and context length
babilong.first_author_affil: AIRI, Moscow, Russia and Neural Networks and Deep Learning Lab, MIPT, Dolgoprudny, Russia

helmet.description: Compare recall with downstream tasks such as passage ranking, citation-grounded answers and summarization.
helmet.input: Long context and a task-specific query
helmet.output: An answer, ranked passage IDs, summary or task label
helmet.assessment: Task-specific metrics by context length; e.g., nDCG@10 for passage ranking and model-based summary grading
helmet.first_author_affil: Princeton Language and Intelligence, Princeton University

longmemeval.description: Recall, update and connect facts from earlier conversations, and abstain when the answer is absent.
longmemeval.input: Timestamped chat sessions and a later question
longmemeval.output: Answer from memory, or an explicit abstention
longmemeval.assessment: Model judge checks correctness against a reference
longmemeval.date_note: First arXiv submission (v1, UTC). The v1 identifies UCLA; an internship is acknowledged separately.

longbench-v2.description: Answer questions requiring reasoning over long documents, code repositories, dialogue or structured data.
longbench-v2.input: Long context, a question and four options
longbench-v2.assessment: Answer-key accuracy, with results broken down by difficulty and context length

graphwalks.description: Traverse a directed graph represented in a long input instead of locating a single inserted fact.
graphwalks.input: Directed graph plus a node and query
graphwalks.output: Set of nodes at the requested depth or parents
graphwalks.assessment: Predicted node set scored against the reference; report split and length
graphwalks.date_note: OpenAI calls it Graphwalks. Google reports GraphWalks with a specific BFS F1 and context-length range.

memoryarena.description: Use knowledge acquired in one session to complete a dependent task in another.
memoryarena.input: An interactive task with dependencies on past sessions.
memoryarena.output: Task actions or answers informed by earlier experience.
memoryarena.assessment: Task success across dependent sessions rather than isolated fact recall.

ref-loft-hard-retrieval.description: Can Long-Context Language Models Subsume Retrieval, RAG, SQL, and More?

ref-mrcr.description: Gemini 1.5 technical report: original Multi-Round Coreference Resolution; not OpenAI MRCR v2
